📈 Learning

Machine learning (ML)

In simple words

A way of building AI in which the computer learns patterns from examples instead of following rules written by a programmer.

A way of building AI where the computer learns patterns from examples (data) instead of being given exact rules by a programmer.

Example. Instead of writing a rule for every kind of spam, engineers show a program thousands of spam and normal emails, and it learns the difference itself.

Lessons that teach it

  • Lesson 2: Machine Learning

Related words

  • Artificial intelligence (AI)Computer systems that can do tasks that usually need human intelligence.
  • ModelA program that has learned patterns from data and uses them to make predictions or create something new.
  • Deep learningMachine learning with neural networks that have many layers.
  • Supervised learningLearning from examples that come with the right answers (labels).
  • Unsupervised learningLearning from data without answers, by finding hidden patterns and groups on its own.
